instances.claim: This tells me that Rutherford Chang chose the penny because Brenner's Lincoln is the most reproduced artwork on Earth.
instances.why: Line 1 states a property of the object and line 2 immediately reports the act of choosing it, so the property is read as the criterion for the choice; nothing anywhere in the draft says how or why Chang came to the cent. Each line is true alone — the motive exists only in the adjacency.
